exposure: Mode of delivery at 8 weeks postpartum
Mode of delivery at 14 months postpartum
cohort: 1,780 participants in the 'Dresden Study on Parenting, Work, and Mental Health' (DREAM) cohort study
finding: While all types of non-spontaneous delivery were associated with more negative birth experiences for both parents, cesarean delivery, particularly unplanned, was associated with stronger parent-infant bonding, potentially mediated by birth experience.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery, both planned and unplanned, was associated with stronger parent-infant bonding in mothers, while only unplanned cesarean section was associated with stronger bonding in fathers at 8 weeks postpartum.
